messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: stanc using filenames for model_name
parts:
Does anyone object to a change in which stanc tries to use the
filename as a basis for a model name? I have a bit of code which will
split the filename of the passed model file and use that as the
model_name if one wasn't provided. To prevent problems, the name is
cleaned to ensure that the resulting model_name satisfies the C++
variable name requirements. This way not every model is called
anon_model.

I'm not sure how this may affect other people so I wanted to ask
before I pushed it.

Cheers,
Marcus

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] stanc using filenames for model_name
parts:
Ok, I've pushed it along with the small change to the documentation.

If the user provides a model name with the --name parameter, then that
is used, otherwise it will strip the directories and file extension
from the model filename and append _model to the result. That string
will then have any invalid characters replaced with _. Hence

stanc test-file.stan

will have a model name of test_file_model.

I also added a check for user specified model names to ensure they
don't have illegal characters. It's not, however, checking for
reserved words. E.G.,

stanc --name=model-name

will produce an error while

stanc --name=class

will not (although the resulting code wouldn't compile.

Cheers,
Marcus
